video_title: Rasheer Fleming Fan Fest Media Availability | 10-2-26

quotes.speaker: Rasheer Fleming
quotes.summary_phrase: Rasheer Fleming on his role and chemistry with teammates
quotes.excerpt: knowing that my role is to help them score the ball and do more like that
quotes.quote: I think I've been doing really well figuring out what to do when I'm playing with, if that makes sense. If I'm with the first team or second team, figuring out what things to do and when with the guys like Buck, JG, Dylan, all those guys, knowing that my role is to help them score the ball and do more like that type of role. And then with the second team, just knowing that I do have an opportunity to look for other options, score the ball, and do the same stuff that I do with the first team.
quotes.social_post: Rasheer Fleming says his role changes depending on the unit he is with. He focuses on facilitating for the first team and looking for his own shot when playing with the second unit.

quotes.speaker: Rasheer Fleming
quotes.summary_phrase: Rasheer Fleming on the development of teammate Koa Peat
quotes.excerpt: he's so young, but he's a very vocal player
quotes.quote: He's such a young player, but he's a very vocal player. So that's an important piece that's with him. It's going to keep him in that leadership type of role. I think he's going to be a great player and great leader in the future.
quotes.social_post: Rasheer Fleming is impressed by Koa Peat early on, noting that the rookie is a very vocal player who is already stepping into a leadership role.

quotes.speaker: Rasheer Fleming
quotes.summary_phrase: Rasheer Fleming on mentoring rookie teammate Koa Peat
quotes.excerpt: we both been in his position, so for him to be the only rookie here
quotes.quote: We both been in his position, so for him to be the only rookie here this year, I know it's probably tough. We had Kaman, Kobe, me, and CJ, so we had a couple rookies last year, so we were able to click together fast. I mean, we click with the whole team now, but just in the beginning, it's kind of hard to click with people at first. But just to bring Koa in that type of situation is for sure helpful for him.
quotes.social_post: Rasheer Fleming says the team is working to help Koa Peat adjust as the only rookie this season, noting that having a group of rookies last year made the transition easier for them.

quotes.speaker: Rasheer Fleming
quotes.summary_phrase: Rasheer Fleming on his defensive growth and communication
quotes.excerpt: being like another defensive anchor alongside Kaman
quotes.quote: The main thing that I've been seeing as making a real big difference is talking more, talking my spots on the floor, talking to help my teammates, especially on defense. I feel like being like another defensive anchor alongside Kaman. I know you all hear him on the court if he's out there, he has a presence on the court, so I think with me talking I could probably do the same thing.
quotes.social_post: Rasheer Fleming is focused on becoming a defensive anchor for the Suns. He says he is working on talking more on the floor to match the defensive presence of Kaman.
